 Your Role
 As a Senior Shopify Full-Stack Developer at Capgemini, you will join an international B2B delivery team supporting the development and evolution of a strategic Shopify-based e-commerce platform for a global leader in the luxury and consumer goods industry. You will leverage your expertise across Shopify, front-end and back-end development, and enterprise integrations to deliver scalable and high-quality commerce solutions in a fast-paced international environment.
 In This Role You Will
Design, develop, and enhance Shopify-based B2B e-commerce solutions.
Configure, customize, and maintain Shopify platforms and environments.
Develop custom Shopify functionalities, integrations, and applications.
Work extensively with Shopify APIs and integration frameworks.
Build and maintain front-end components using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Shopify Liquid.
Develop and support back-end services and full-stack integration solutions.
Collaborate closely with architects, product owners, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to transform business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Troubleshoot complex technical issues and contribute to continuous platform improvements.
Ensure adherence to coding standards, security requirements, and software development best practices.
Participate in solution design discussions and support technical decision-making processes.
Contribute to Agile ceremonies and collaborate with globally distributed teams.

 Proven experience as a Senior Shopify Full-Stack Developer.
 Strong Expertise In

 Experience delivering enterprise-scale e-commerce solutions.

Proactive and solution-oriented mindset.Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
